title: 煅玉堂 第八十九章 四种神物煅玉堂 第八十八章 烈阳坊市
content_zh:
血炎晶、幻砃汁、龙神骨、魔魂花。
看着秦凤鸣清单上列出的四个名字，谷阳金仙立即眉头皱起：“秦大师，这四种材料不好找寻，其中老夫也只识得两种，幻砃汁与龙神骨不知何物，想必非常珍贵。就算哪位道友有，没有动心的兑换之物，也没人愿意拿出。”
秦凤鸣微微一笑，神情平静道：“不知焚脉固精丹与玄牝锁阳丹是否能够兑换到？”
这两种丹药既然已经暴露，那秦凤鸣自然也不用藏着掖着，直接说出了。
“什么？大师身上有这两种丹药？”
身为金仙大能，当然知道这两种丹药是何物，一个是淬炼修士的经脉，一个则是稳固修士本源。可以说这是两种对修士肉身有逆天好处的丹药。并且无论是对金仙，还是对真仙，何两种丹药都可以服食炼化。
“不错，这两种丹药秦某正好有。”秦凤鸣点头。
“好，老夫为大师奔走一番，说不定真能有收获。”谷阳双目中溢彩闪烁，立即答应了。
秦凤鸣当然知道谷阳心中所想，不外乎是想表现好，从他手中兑换丹药。
这是可接受的，秦凤鸣自然不会拒绝。
秦凤鸣心中欢喜，有钱能使鬼推磨，这是万古恒定的至理。不理会谷阳金仙如何发布悬赏，他回到了自己的洞府空间。就此盘坐下来。
没有董迁与丁原在外面照看，他不能安心闭关炼丹。此时只能等候，期待汤巍真仙带着两人快点到来。
三日后，没有等到董迁两人，却等来了悬赏消息。
跟随一位烈阳门修士，秦凤鸣出现在了一处广场上，应谷阳金仙所请，他必需拿出两枚丹药让群修亲眼见识一番，否则悬赏会反应平平。
秦凤鸣并不反对，故此现身广场。
越轰动，引动的修士数量越多，他就越安全，到时他出离坊市，定会有大量修士相随。不管有几名魔阴宫真仙，也定然不会对他出手。
“玄牝锁阳丹！真的是玄牝锁阳丹！”
秦凤鸣拿出一枚丹药，对着广场上数千修士展现，立即有真仙惊呼出声。这做不得假，因为丹药所显现的气息根本无人能够造假。
再拿出一枚丹药，惊呼声再次响彻在广场上。
“各位道友与各位前辈，秦某身上丹药数量有限，故此先到先得，如果有四种材料，还请速速找秦某兑换。”秦凤鸣满意群修反应，高声道。

“不知秦道友如何兑换？老夫这里有一瓶幻砃汁。”紧随秦凤鸣话语，一道身影飘身出现在了石台之上。这是一位金仙，白面无须，五十多岁年纪。
“前辈有幻砃汁？好极了，请拿出让晚辈看看。”秦凤鸣大喜。
金仙挥手，一只玉瓶送到了秦凤鸣面前。他没有撤去玉瓶上的禁制，大有考验秦凤鸣之意。
秦凤鸣接过玉瓶，手指点出，一团灵纹闪现，然后一声淡淡的脆鸣响起，玉瓶盖子一弹而开，瓶中物立即显露在了秦凤鸣面前。
“前辈，你玉瓶中的幻砃汁太少了些，还不足以兑换一枚焚脉固精丹。不过可以兑换一枚金元丹，不知前辈可愿意吗？”秦凤鸣合起玉瓶，看向金仙道。
content_en:
Blood Flame Crystal, Phantom Juice, Dragon God Bone, Demonic Soul Flower.
Looking at the four names listed on Qin Fengming's list, Guyang Jinxian immediately frowned: "Master Qin, these four materials are difficult to find, and I only know two of them. I don't know what the phantom juice and the dragon bone are. They must be very precious. Even if any fellow Taoist has it, no one is willing to exchange it for it."
Qin Fengming smiled slightly and said calmly: "I wonder if the Burning Pulse Consolidating Essence Pill and the Xuan Ni Suoyang Pill can be exchanged?"
Since these two elixirs have been exposed, Qin Fengming naturally doesn't need to hide them and speaks out directly.
"What? Master has these two kinds of elixirs on his body?"
As a powerful golden immortal, of course he knows what these two elixirs are. One is to temper the meridians of the monks, and the other is to stabilize the origin of the monks. It can be said that these are two pills that are extremely beneficial to the monk's body. And whether it is for golden immortals or true immortals, both kinds of elixirs can be taken and refined.
"Yes, Qin just happens to have these two kinds of elixirs." Qin Fengming nodded.
"Okay, I'll work hard for the master, maybe I can really gain something." Gu Yang's eyes flashed, and he immediately agreed.
Of course Qin Fengming knew what Gu Yang was thinking, and he just wanted to behave well and exchange the pill from him.
This is acceptable, and Qin Fengming will naturally not refuse.
Qin Fengming was happy in his heart. Money can make ghosts grind. This is the eternal truth. Ignoring how Guyang Jinxian issued a reward, he returned to his cave space. Just sit down cross-legged.
Without Dong Qian and Ding Yuan to take care of him outside, he could not rest in seclusion to refine alchemy. At this time, we can only wait and hope that Immortal Tang Wei and the two of them will arrive soon.
Three days later, Dong Qian and his two men were not waiting, but news of a reward was waiting.
Following a Lieyang Sect monk, Qin Fengming appeared in a square. At the request of Guyang Golden Immortal, he had to take out two elixirs for the cultivators to see with their own eyes, otherwise the reward would be met with mediocre response.
Qin Fengming did not object, so he appeared in the square.
The more sensational it is and the more monks it attracts, the safer he will be. When he leaves the city, a large number of monks will definitely follow him. No matter how many true immortals there are in the Demonic Yin Palace, they will definitely not take action against him.
"Xuan Ni Suoyang Pill! It's really Xuan Ni Suoyang Pill!"
Qin Fengming took out an elixir and showed it to thousands of monks in the square, and some real immortals immediately exclaimed. This cannot be faked, because no one can fake the aura displayed by the elixir.
He took out another pill, and the exclamations resounded in the square again.
"Fellow Taoists and seniors, Qin has a limited number of pills, so they are on a first-come, first-served basis. If you have four materials, please exchange them with Qin as soon as possible." Qin Fengming was satisfied with the reaction of the group of cultivators and said loudly.
"I wonder how fellow Daoist Qin can redeem it? I have a bottle of Huan Feng juice here." Following Qin Fengming's words, a figure appeared on the stone platform. This is a golden immortal, fair-faced and beardless, in his fifties.
"Senior, do you have the magic juice? It's great, please show it to me, junior." Qin Fengming was overjoyed.
Jin Xian waved his hand and a jade bottle was delivered to Qin Fengming. He did not remove the restrictions on the jade bottle, which was a test for Qin Fengming.
Qin Fengming took the jade bottle, pointed it out with his finger, and a group of spiritual patterns flashed, and then a faint crisp sound sounded. The lid of the jade bottle popped open, and the contents of the bottle were immediately revealed in front of Qin Fengming.
"Senior, there is too little Huanzhen Juice in your jade bottle, and it is not enough to exchange for a Burning Pulse Consolidating Essence Pill. However, it can be exchanged for a Jin Yuan Pill. I wonder if you are willing, senior?" Qin Fengming closed the jade bottle and looked at Jin Xiandao.
